title: Mission: The Garage Door
subtitle: Build the garage door and see how it opens and closes.
summary: Meet the garage door, learn its parts, and use the opener to raise it.
activityInstruction: Draw a path from the car to its parking space, then watch it park.

storyQuestions.prompt: Is the garage door open or closed?

storyQuestions.success: No, the car cannot go inside.

storyQuestions.prompt: What does Dad use to open the door?
storyQuestions.success: Dad uses his hands to open the door.

storyQuestions.prompt: Is the door light or heavy?

storyQuestions.success: No, Dad cannot open it easily.

quiz.success: The motor turns the chain to move the door.

quiz.prompt: What part opens and closes the entrance?
quiz.success: The door panel covers the entrance.

quiz.prompt: What stops the door from closing on someone?
quiz.success: A safety sensor reverses the door.

quiz.prompt: What guides the door as it moves?
quiz.success: The track guides the door up and down.

parts.label: Motor
parts.fact: The motor turns the chain to lift and lower the door.
parts.help: The box at the top of the track.

parts.label: Pulleys
parts.fact: The pulleys guide the lifting cable and help the motor raise the heavy door.
parts.help: Look near the motor and lifting mechanism above the door.

parts.label: Rails
parts.fact: The rails guide the garage door as it moves up and down.
parts.help: Look for the metal guides along both sides of the door.
